# KABP Arbuda Plastic

> Manufacturer and bulk wholesaler of PVC and EVA footwear (slippers, sandals, slides, school shoes) in Vasai East, Maharashtra, India. Established 2014. All products are made in-house and sold under our own brand, KABP. Wholesale and bulk buyers only; no retail sales.

## Company
- Legal/trade name: KABP Arbuda Plastic (also known as Arbuda Plastic)
- Founded: 2014
- Factory: 1st Floor, Meghdoot Signature, Gala No. 103, Plot No. 22, Behind IPOL, Waliv Phata, Sativali, Vasai East, Maharashtra 401208, India
- GSTIN: 27AGUPP3374Q1Z8
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8 am to 8 pm IST. Closed Sunday.
- Factory visits welcome by appointment for wholesale buyers.
- We are not a contract or private-label (OEM) manufacturer. Every pair is sold under the KABP brand.

## Products
- 45 styles: 39 EVA, 6 PVC.
- Categories: men's and women's slippers, sandals, slides, children's and school shoes.
- Made end to end in our factory: granule batching and colour matching, hydraulic moulding, hand finishing and checking, dispatch.
- [Full product catalogue with sizes and colours](https://www.arbudaplastic.co.in/products.html)
- [Downloadable PDF catalogue](https://www.arbudaplastic.co.in/arbuda-catalogue.pdf)

## Wholesale terms
- Minimum order: varies by product and location; contact us. 1 carton holds 60 to 178 pairs depending on product and size. Small first orders welcome.
- Payment: advance payment, then dispatch. Where credit is agreed in writing, maximum 45 days as per the MSMED Act, 2006.
- Dispatch: next day after payment, or as soon as stock is ready. Delivery within 7 working days.
- Samples: sample cost is adjusted against the first order.
- Returns: defective or wrongly shipped goods returned or exchanged within 7 days of delivery.
- Warranty: 6 months against material and workmanship defects.
- Area served: all of India.

## How to order
1. Send styles, sizes and quantity on WhatsApp or phone.
2. Receive a quote for your order.
3. Confirm quantities, dispatch date and payment terms.
4. Order is packed in cartons and dispatched from the factory.
